findings.title: Hub module (imported by 73)
findings.evidence: 73 modules depend on this one; churn here is high-blast-radius.
findings.recommendation: Keep it stable and small; move volatile logic out.

findings.title: High branching density
findings.evidence: 34 branch points over 64 lines.
findings.recommendation: Decompose decision-heavy logic; consider table/strategy dispatch.
